invented.quote: The Long Dark Season: Keep the Light Burning
invented.why: The brief does not give a title or subtitle for the board game.

invented.quote: The supply boat won't come again until spring. The oil has to last, the children have to eat, and ships need the light every night.
invented.why: The brief only states that the game is about seeing a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without mentioning supply boats, oil, children, or ships.

invented.quote: on an island at the edge of the map.
invented.why: The brief does not specify that the lighthouse is located on an island.

invented.quote: Each turn you decide what gets done today and what has to wait: fixing the lamp, rationing the stores, caring for someone who's sick, or going out in the storm.
invented.why: The brief does not describe the turn structure, daily actions, or specific tasks in the game.

invented.quote: No two winters play out the same, and the hardest choices often have nothing to do with the light.
invented.why: The brief gives no details about replayability or the nature of the choices in the game.

invented.quote: Tested at hundreds of tables, one game at a time
invented.why: The brief states there were 140 playtest sessions, which is not hundreds.

invented.quote: families, first-timers, longtime hobby gamers and solo players.
invented.why: The brief states that about 60 different people playtested the game, but gives no demographic or experience details about them.
The brief does not state that changes were made after every playtest session.
The brief states the creator took the game to two conventions, but does not state the reason why.

invented.quote: The rest: platform and payment fees, plus a reserve for freight and surprises
invented.why: The brief does not state that the remainder of the funding goal after manufacturing and shipping is allocated to platform fees, payment fees, freight, or a reserve.

invented.quote: It doesn't include any pay for me.
invented.why: The brief does not mention whether the creator is taking any pay from the campaign funds.

invented.quote: If we go past the goal, the extra money gives the project a safety margin before any stretch goals.
invented.why: The brief mentions nothing about stretch goals or how overfunding will be used.

invented.quote: To lower that risk, I locked in the manufacturing quote before launch, budgeted shipping per copy, and built a reserve into the goal.
invented.why: The brief states the creator has a factory quote and a shipping cost estimate, but does not state the quote is locked in or that a reserve was built into the goal to lower risk.

invented.quote: This game has been through four winters of playtesting.
invented.why: The brief only says playtesting has happened since 2023, not that it has spanned four winters.
